The only fully opensource software package providing a complete pipeline from medical image data segmentation to patient specific blood flow simulation and analysis.

SimVascular is an interactive application used to create patient-specific geometric models of human vasculature from 3D medical imaging data acquired for a specific anatomical region. These models are then used as the basis for blood flow simulations using various numerical methods.

Website: https://simvascular.github.io  Wiki: https://github.com/SimVascular/SimVascular/wiki  Source code: https://github.com/SimVascular/SimVascular
